div.div:
Four dimensions: complacency / distrust / over-caution / calibrated trust.
A correct action alone is not proof of calibrated trust. A bad outcome alone is not proof of misuse.
NPC omissions, unseen advice, technical failures and interrupted sessions require explicit exclusions.
